headline: GIFT Nifty Jumps 200 Points Signaling Positive Start Despite Tech Rout in Asian Markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty signals a positive start for Indian markets with a 200-point jump
Tech-heavy Asian indices like Kospi and Nikkei face sharp declines due to AI-trade unwind
Investors are cautious ahead of key US inflation data and Federal Reserve policy cues
Markets are recovering from a significant sell-off earlier in the week that impacted major sectors
whatHappening: GIFT Nifty is trading significantly higher, suggesting a gap-up opening for the Nifty 50 index
South Korea's Kospi has plunged 5% as global tech stocks face a significant rout
Goldman Sachs and Societe Generale have invested ₹920 crore in Lenskart
Aeravti Ventures has secured 50% of its ₹300 crore second fund at first close
summary: Indian markets are expected to open higher following a 200-point surge in GIFT Nifty, contrasting with a tech-led sell-off in Asian markets. Investors are monitoring US inflation data and the impact of the AI-trade unwind on global technology stocks. This follows a period of high volatility where the Sensex saw a major 1,484-point drop earlier in the week.
